final_report: The patient has low-grade hematologic toxicities (neutropenia, anemia) indicative of manageable chemotherapy-related bone marrow suppression, not marrow failure. Resolved lipase elevation and spinal pain suggest transient pancreatic irritation and non-critical musculoskeletal issues. ECOG 1 performance status and absence of organ failure or hemodynamic compromise support a favorable short-term prognosis. Current smoking adds moderate risk but does not outweigh the overall stable clinical picture.
